# QS-CFW-2573-68 Quality specification - axle hub CFW-2573-68 (4140)

Scope
- Applies to forged axle hub CFW-2573-68 manufactured at Plant: P3 under Revision: Rev C.
- Defines acceptance criteria and inspection methods for material and critical features prior to release to machining and assembly.

Requirements table
| Feature | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Material | 4140 (per purchase order and material certificate) |
| Hardness | The hardness range for axle hub CFW-2573-68 (CFW-2573-68) is 25-31 HRC. |
| Bore tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for axle hub CFW-2573-68 (CFW-2573-68) is ±0.03 mm. |
| Forging weight | The maximum forging weight for axle hub CFW-2573-68 (CFW-2573-68) is 97.2 kg. |

Inspection method
- Visual: Inspect for surface continuity, laps, seams, and severe scale. Reject parts with indications that could affect fit or integrity.
- Dimensional: Verify bore diameter using calibrated bore gauge or CMM. Record measured value and compare to the bore diameter tolerance stated in the table.
- Hardness: Perform standardized hardness testing on machined or prepared surfaces using a calibrated Rockwell tester. Report results and compare to the hardness requirement stated in the table.
- Weight: Verify forging weight on a calibrated scale to confirm compliance with the maximum forging weight specified in the table.
- Traceability: Each lot must be accompanied by a material certificate and heat number mapped to part serials and inspection records.

Nonconformance handling
- Parts failing any requirement in the table shall be segregated, tagged, and documented with root cause and disposition.
- Disposition options: rework if permitted by engineering, scrap, or return to supplier. Rework must be documented and re-inspected to the same criteria.
- Records: Retain inspection reports, hardness readings, weight records, and material certificates with the lot per document retention policy.
- Escalation: Quality Manager must approve any disposition that deviates from the requirements in this specification.
